size.value: Not more than 63mm x 50mm (2½ x 2 inches) and not less than 52mm x 37mm (2 x 1½ inches)

validity.value: Photographs must be sufficiently recent, not more than six months old

clothing_restriction.value: Applicant should be dressed in normal attire without hat, a doek (head wrap) or braids. Only applicants who serve in uniformed government departments (Armed Forces, Police, Immigration, etc.) applying for diplomatic or official passports may submit photographs wearing a Botswana Government uniform.

face_visibility.value: Photographs must be clear, front view, full face, taken full face - head and shoulders - with light plain background

headwear_policy.value: No hat/doek. Special exception may be allowed for headgear only if it is part of regional attire worn daily; uniforms or head covering which obscure the applicant's features (hair or hairline) may not be worn.

clothing.en: Normal attire; no hat, doek (head wrap), or braids. Government-uniformed applicants (military, police, immigration) may wear uniform only when applying for a diplomatic or official passport.
clothing.ko: 일반 복장 착용, 모자·두건(doek)·땋은 머리 장식 금지. 제복 근무자(군·경찰·이민국)는 외교관·관용여권 신청 시에만 정부 제복 착용 가능.
clothing.ja: 普段着を着用し、帽子・ドーク(頭巾)・編み込み髪の装飾は不可。制服着用の公務員(軍・警察・移民局)は外交・公用旅券申請時に限り政府制服の着用可。

face_visibility.en: Full face, head and shoulders, clear front view, against a light plain background.
face_visibility.ko: 정면에서 얼굴 전체와 머리·어깨가 선명하게 나와야 하며, 배경은 밝고 무늬 없는 단색이어야 함.
face_visibility.ja: 正面から顔全体と頭・肩が鮮明に写ること。背景は明るい無地であること。

headwear.en: No hat, doek, or head covering permitted; exception only for headgear that forms part of daily regional/traditional dress.
headwear.ko: 모자·두건 등 머리가리개 착용 불가. 일상적으로 착용하는 전통·지역 복식의 일부인 경우에만 예외 인정.
headwear.ja: 帽子やドークなどの被り物は不可。日常的に着用する民族衣装・地域衣装の一部である場合のみ例外を認める。
